searchText: Hi Everyone, Could someone please help with one query regarding EIP-4844? Is it possible to invoke a function and pass its parameter as blob? Via passing those parameter as blob , I am aiming to reduce the gas consumed in a transaction. This channel is archived (in the "graveyard") but I'll answer: no you can't do that. The EVM doesn't have access to any of the blob data. The blob data is designed for "L2s" and other systems built on top of Ethereum that need some data availability.
